articles.title: Blood sugar crossed 600
articles.description: Actor Ram Kapoor opened up about his severe health struggles during the peak of his television career, revealing that his weight gain, depression, and unhealthy lifestyle pushed him towards a dangerous diabetes crisis. He said his blood sugar levels crossed 600 mg/dL and doctors warned him about the risk of a diabetic stroke and life-threatening complications. Experts explained that such extremely high blood sugar levels can trigger a medical emergency called Hyperosmolar Hyperglycaemic State (HHS), leading to dehydration, confusion, coma, or even death if untreated. Long-term uncontrolled diabetes can damage blood vessels and increase the risk of stroke, heart disease, kidney problems, vision loss, and nerve damage. Doctors stressed the importance of recognising warning signs, regular health checks, medication, a balanced diet, exercise, and consistent monitoring to prevent serious complications.
